reason: Three defects in src/nebula/v3/tool_results.py. First, ToolOutputService.search used the 0.25 s regex guard (regex_deadline_seconds) as the wall clock for the whole scan, so a plain literal search over any tool artifact above roughly 1-2 MB raised 'search deadline exceeded' (422 over REST, an error to the agent) before reaching its match; the service now has its own search_seconds budget (5 s), passes the regex guard through as the per-line regex timeout as WorkspaceOutputService already did, and when the budget does run out it returns an explicit partial page (truncated, reason, continuation_cursor) whose cursor resumes at the first line whose match had not been reported, so no match is skipped or repeated even with pending after-context. Second, a continuation cursor whose artifact no longer belongs to the call silently produced an empty, non-truncated result; it now raises 'continuation cursor is no longer available; restart the search' like the workspace sibling. Third, sanitize_model_history_result replayed legacy {} and {'detail': ...} payloads as status 'failed' because the status/detail/rule envelope branch accepted any subset of those keys; it now requires a recorded status string and lets the rest fall through to the bounded legacy receipt. tests/v3/test_automation_runtime.py gains test_tool_output_search_budget_is_separate_from_the_regex_guard (a 3 MB literal search finds the last line), test_tool_output_search_reports_budget_exhaustion_with_a_resumable_cursor (a faked clock exhausts the budget every ~20 lines with context_lines=2 and the paged results are exactly lines 1..400 with intact context), test_tool_output_search_rejects_a_cursor_that_no_longer_resolves and test_legacy_results_without_a_recorded_status_are_not_replayed_as_failed; the existing regex-guard assertion now expects 'regular-expression search timed out' since a zero regex guard no longer masquerades as the search deadline. tests/v3/test_workspace_tool_search.py is selected because WorkspaceOutputService shares _Matcher.matches and _matching_lines, which now raise the private _SearchBudgetExhausted subclass and carry the resume position; its budget and regex-timeout assertions prove the workspace behaviour is unchanged. All five new or changed tests fail on origin/main.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change (the UI client reads continuation_cursor optionally and ignores the added reason key). No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through src/nebula/v3/tool_results.py) does not exercise tool_output.search on multi-megabyte artifacts, stale cursors, or legacy history replay; the Python tests drive ToolOutputService and sanitize_model_history_result directly. No full suites.
